name: Golden Triangle (Delhi–Agra–Jaipur)
about: Oct–Mar is comfortably cool and the classic touring season, summer (Apr–Jun) is extremely hot, monsoon (Jul–Sep) is humid with heavy rain.
overview: India's classic first-time circuit — Mughal forts, the Taj Mahal, and Rajasthan's pink-walled capital.
costOverview: Street food, chai, and rickshaws cost almost nothing — the Taj Mahal's foreign-visitor entrance fee is one of the most expensive single tickets in India.
